name: Today is someone's last day on Earth

lines.ref: Today is someone's last day on Earth

shots.brief: pensive or neutral selfie sitting on public transit or looking out a window (ref: Young woman wearing over-ear headphones sitting on a moving train/bus, looking into camera with subtle contemplation and a slight smile at the end.; selfie)
doing something physically challenging, thrilling, or slightly intimidating (ref: Woman sandboarding down desert sand dunes, losing balance and running down.; filmed by friend)
walking outdoors alone, smiling selfie (ref: Woman walking down a quiet street alone with a backpack, smiling at camera.; selfie)
looking hesitant, chilly, or uncertain during an outdoor activity (ref: Woman on a foggy mountain summit holding a walking stick, looking nervous and cold.; filmed by friend)
budget travel, moving, or improvised transit moment (ref: Riding on the back of a moped carrying luggage between two passengers.; selfie)
running freely away from camera down an open road or park path (ref: Woman running barefoot away from camera down an open palm-tree-lined road with arms spread.; tripod)

audit.notes: Extremely easy to recreate with existing lifestyle and NYC b-roll. Open with a contemplative subway selfie for the hook, followed by 5 quick cuts matching the prompts: climbing gym/bouldering fall ('Do it scared'), solo city walk ('Do it alone'), working late or learning something new ('Do it unsure'), budget meal/cooking at home ('Do it broke'), and running through Central Park or crossing Brooklyn Bridge ('Do it anyway').
audit.summary: A viral motivational hook ('Today is someone's last day on Earth') set over a transit selfie, followed by quick cuts of travel and adventure b-roll paired with punchy 'Do it...' affirmations.
